name: esp32-dots
description: Connect to the verified local ESP32 Dots MCP bridge for TFT control and aggregate camera events.

interface.longDescription: Read the verified ESP32 state, receive camera scene changes, and switch the Dots TFT between READY and HAPPY. The local runtime handles pixels in memory. ChatGPT cloud access uses the separately configured existing Secure MCP Tunnel.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my ESP32 Dots connection and subscribe to camera scene changes.
